data.name: Raining Cats and Dogs
data.detailed_description:
It's quite literally Raining Cats and Dogs. This game is a part of a video game series where I  (JustJeff) grab idioms and turns them into literal games. This game is similar to other games "Break a Leg" and "Beat Around the Bush" where all you do is break a leg or beat around the bush.

In Raining cats and dogs, your goal is to reach the end and make it stop raining cats and dogs. There's a light switch at the end of the game that you can turn off so the cats and dogs can stop dying. Your goal is to platform across the landscape and climb as high as you can without being knocked off by a random cat or dog. If the cat or dog hits you, you get damaged and have force added to your character, flinging you in any direction. 

On top of that, the twist is - The the top YouTube Shorts from my YouTube are actually added game. This adds for some silly gameplay features, for example - a crocodile falls out of the sky and talks to you about biscuits and tea, and all of the good and bad things about them.

The platforming unique. You can move, jump, dash, crouch, crouch slide, crouch jump and pop an umbrella to temporarily lower your gravity. This game also has almost 100 different unique obstacles designed to challenge you. These obstacles include lasers and lava that kill you upon hitting you. Some would call this a Foddian Game. But this game has difficulties - making you rage less if you don't like Foddian games.

If you're pretty good at obstacles and platforming, this game should take you a couple hours. To get through all the comments though, that'll take a couple hours in of itself. 

The game has a villain who is me - Jeff. I make it rain the cats and dogs, you can't stop me. Or can you? I designed a course specifically to make you not stop me. If you want to make it stop raining cats and dogs, you must beat me in an evenly balanced boss fight. I didn't even mention yet - this game includes three boss fights and items to help you platform/beat the bosses.

CATS AND DOGS DIE EVERY SECOND YOU'RE NOT PLAYING THIS GAME MUAHAHAHA

-Jeff

data.short_description: It’s literally raining cats and dogs. In this game you platform, overcome about 100 unique obstacles, fight 3 janky bosses, find comments added from YouTube Shorts and make it stop raining cats and dogs by fighting Jeff in the end. Here's a message from Jeff: "YOU WILL NEVER STOP ME YEEEHAWWW"

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470 with 4 GB VRAM
